overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session on January 25 for a performance-evaluation purpose that is not a permissible executive session topic, and ordered compliance and release of the related minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session at its January 25 meeting without a proper statutory purpose, citing an 'Update on Performance Evaluations' topic.
allegations.key_passage: For these reasons, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session without a lawful purpose.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

Release to the public, within 30 days of receipt of the letter (if not already done), the portion of the January 25 executive session minutes relating to the impermissible performance evaluations discussion.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law. We also order the Board, if it has not already done so, to release to the public within 30 days of receipt of this letter the portion of the January 25 executive session meeting minutes which relate to the impermissible “performance evaluations” discussion.
